en: The image shows the reverse side of an old postcard. There is a vertical dividing line separating the address area on the right from the message on the left. On the right, a name and town are written in cursive German script, with space for a stamp in the upper left corner. Along the bottom edge, printed text in German identifies the printer or publisher. The handwriting is in dark ink and appears to be dated in the early 20th century.
